title: Recruitment Operating System
headline: Nine stages. One coherent hiring journey.
system: A manual hiring pipeline meant scattered reporting and inconsistent scoring. I designed an event-driven architecture for ingestion, AI summaries, rule-based stage movement, candidate reports, and error handling.
impact: Standardised scorecards, pipeline visibility, and audit trails. Human approval remains at every subjective stage.

title: AI Voice Interview Scheduler
headline: From candidate outreach to a confirmed interview.
system: An end-to-end voice assistant handles candidate outreach and scheduling. n8n routes real-time call outcomes while Airtable tracks candidate records, preferred slots, and scheduling status.
impact: Connected voice conversations, calendar availability, and recruitment records in one workflow.

title: Performance Intelligence
headline: Make the signals visible. Keep the decisions human.
system: I designed a framework that brings execution, responsiveness, time tracking, and process compliance into daily and weekly reporting, with four-tier risk scoring and timezone-aware check-ins.
impact: Earlier evidence-based manager intervention and recognition, with clear human decision boundaries.

title: Telegram HR Assistant
headline: Everyday HR support, inside a conversation.
system: A Telegram-based assistant for leave requests, policy explanations, attendance checks, and routine HR questions, connected to workflows that store and retrieve employee data.
impact: Accessible support that reduces repetitive HR coordination.

title: Culturecore
headline: Give company culture a structure to grow in.
system: A SaaS platform to help HR teams and founders define, document, and measure company culture. I shaped the architecture, interface, and business logic using AI-assisted development.
impact: A responsive product with structured culture documentation and thoughtful interaction.

title: AI Career Coach
headline: Practical career support, personalised.
system: I built a Flask application that reviews CVs, drafts cover letters, and provides career guidance using Gemini, PDF parsing, and a Google Sheets integration.
impact: An end-to-end career support experience, from document input to contextual guidance.

title: AI Onboarding Agent
headline: A warmer welcome. Less manual follow-up.
system: An event-driven onboarding assistant built with n8n, MistralAI, and Tally. Form submissions trigger welcome flows, resource sharing, and reminders.
impact: Connected new-hire inputs to a conversational onboarding journey.

title: Career Recommendation Engine
headline: Match interests with possibilities.
system: A semantic recommendation system using sentence transformers and cosine similarity to match student interests with career paths beyond literal keyword matching.
impact: A complete pipeline from data preparation to an interactive recommendation demo.

title: Leave & Accountability Workflows
headline: Small operations. Meaningful relief.
system: Leave approvals notify managers, communicate decisions, and update balances in Google Sheets. ClickBot automates timezone-aware start/end-of-day and time-tracking check-ins.
impact: An auditable leave approval path and more consistent visibility across a distributed team.

title: Job Application Tracker
headline: Keep the job search in one place.
system: A Flask dashboard, background email monitoring, and a lightweight Chrome extension for sourcing and tracking job applications, with portable CSV storage.
impact: A locally hosted workflow for recording opportunities and application progress.
